arabic text:
Sakina so rahi hai
Sunaayi Kisne Yeh Zindaa(n) me lori Sakina so rahi hai
Khudara zor se bole na koi
Sakina so rahi hai
Sunaayi Kisne Yeh Zindaa(n) me lori Sakina so rahi hai
english translation text:
Sakina is sleeping
Who sang this lullaby in the prison? Sakina is sleeping
For God’s sake, let no one speak loudly.
Sakina is sleeping.
Who sang this lullaby in the prison? Sakina is sleeping

arabic text:
Tumhaare Goshwaare milgaye hain
Dar-e-zindaan saare khulgaye hain
Rihayi milgayi jaati hun gharko
magar Sajjad ki awaaz aayi
Sakina so rahi hai
Sunaayi Kisne Yeh Zindaa(n) me lori Sakina so rahi hai
english translation text:
Your earrings have been found.
All the prison doors have opened.
We have been freed; I am going home
But then Sajjad’s voice was heard: …
Sakina is sleeping.
Who sang this lullaby in the prison? Sakina is sleeping

arabic text:
Banaane Kabr ko Sajjad Uthe
To woh naad-e-ali dohra rahe the
Bande hatoun se chahaa kabr khoden
achanak paun ki zanjir chanki
Sakina so rahi hai
Sunaayi Kisne Yeh Zindaa(n) me lori Sakina so rahi hai
english translation text:
Sajjad rose to prepare the grave.
He kept repeating Nad-e-Ali.
With his bound hands he tried to dig the grave
Suddenly the chain on his feet rang out.
Sakina is sleeping.
Who sang this lullaby in the prison? Sakina is sleeping

arabic text:
Na maarega koi bhi tamaache
na honge ab tere yeh rukhsaar neele
Galaa bandaa najaayega rasan se
Jo Aaye Shimr to usse Kahungi
Sakina so rahi hai
Sunaayi Kisne Yeh Zindaa(n) me lori Sakina so rahi hai
english translation text:
No one will slap you anymore.
Your cheeks will no longer be bruised blue.
A rope will never again be tied around your neck
If Shimr comes, I will tell him: …
Sakina is sleeping.
Who sang this lullaby in the prison? Sakina is sleeping

arabic text:
Adab ki jaah ye "Rehan" dekho
Buland awaaz mei har giz na bolo
Yaha to fateha bhi dheere parhna
Yaha awaaz ho jaye na unchi
Sakina so rahi hai
(Sunaayi Kisne Yeh Zindaa(n) me lori
english translation text:
Look, Rehan, this is a place of reverence.
Never speak here in a loud voice.
Even the Fatiha must be recited softly here
Let no voice rise here.
Sakina is sleeping.
Who sang this lullaby in the prison …
